title: Atlas Quest
description: Spin a 3D globe and paint the world in flags! Find countries on the map, match flags, hop between capitals, and go on a culture quest through food, festivals, music, words and wildlife. Teachers make their own geography quiz (map labels, capitals, flags, their own questions, or questions drafted from a lesson they upload), share it by link, QR code or class code, assign it, and print it as a worksheet, with blank maps where small countries get an arrow to an answer line. A geography library covers every country plus continents, oceans, rivers, mountains, deserts and lakes.
notes: Screens in Crossword's look since Nov 2026 (docs/decisions.md "Atlas Quest in Crossword's look"): the page's own DOM in the classroom dashboard's widget style (cream cards with a group colour on the top edge and the icon chip, the dark Now-style question bar, Bricolage Grotesque from Google Fonts, light and dark from the site theme through the kit), the 3D globe on a board card over the dotted mint board; the kit is still loaded for the words (Oomba.t and the language packs), the map palette, icons, sounds, the clock and read aloud. One door (docs/decisions.md "Atlas Quest: one door"): a grown-up who may host or make first sees Who is it for? (Play, Host live through BRB.hostLive, Build a lesson with the teacher tools below); a student or a child goes straight to the games, and a quiz link or class code plays the quiz. Make your own geography quiz (grown-ups who may host, BRB.canMake; AI lesson upload too): question types map label, name the capital, capital to country, flag to country, continent, famous for, and the teacher's own question with its answer; a region's countries, random ones or hand-picked; Upload a geography lesson (PDF, Word or .txt, through BRB.wordsFromDoc and services/atlas-doc.js, set-ai.js draftGeoQuiz). Saved as a question set (game-sets.js cleanAtlasItems: ISO codes from the game's list, the teacher's words through the text filter), with class code, link, QR, Copy, Assign, drafts in the game save (field mine) and My worksheets. Students open a link or class code and play it (typed answers with Check; one BRB.gameOver at the end). Print (services/atlas-print.js): the quiz worksheet, a blank map of any region, the answer key for staff; the outline map is drawn on the server by the game's own atlas-map block, and small countries get an arrow to an answer line the teacher can drag in the builder. The geography library: every country's facts from AtlasData plus a hand-written facts set (window.AtlasFacts, English). Originally built on the Oomba Kit 1.1.1 (pinned kit tag plus the art-animals pack) over the built-in Three.js 0.185.1 (pinned import map with integrity), like Code Isle and Star Island: the kit's title, dialogs (the guide, Captain Skye, is a kit duck), results (Oomba.ui.win), toasts, settings, cards, buttons, icons, sounds, font, day/night theme and palette; Oomba.time.start() runs the kit clock. The globe: a sphere wrapped in a canvas map (equirectangular, 4096 wide) drawn from a simplified Natural Earth 50m map (public domain, via world-atlas; quantised to 0.1 degree, delta-coded) with every country outlined; tiny countries (Monaco, Vatican, Maldives...) get a tappable dot; taps are a raycast to latitude/longitude plus a point-in-polygon test. Drag to spin, pinch or wheel to zoom, arrow keys too. Countries: the 193 UN members plus the two observer states (window.AtlasData): flag (flag-icons, MIT; SVG, or a small WebP for the ones with detailed coats of arms), capital and its spot, people, languages, neighbours, coast, a 'famous for' phrase and a fun fact. Modes: Find it (tap the country; a miss says how far and which way; Explorer mode adds 'where is this capital?'), Flag match (flag to country and back), Capital hop, Daily expedition (8 clue stops, the same route for everyone each day, with a streak), Speed round (60 seconds of flags and capitals, best score kept), Culture quest (1,170 hand-written culture questions, six per country: food, celebrations, arts, words, nature and everyday life, each with a 'why' that teaches one more detail) and Country files (tap any country: its card, read aloud, its culture finds, and a quiz). Hints: find questions narrow down in three steps (the continent, a neighbour, a circle); four-answer questions lose two wrong answers. Easy (about 80 famous countries) or Explorer (all 195), and any one continent. Flag colouring: a country you get right is painted with its own flag on the globe (see-through while you learn it, full colour once 3 right answers light it up; tiny countries get a flag pin); mistakes come back more often. A right answer turns the globe to the country (no plane or dotted trail since Nov 2026: the owner found it too busy). Passport: stamps (every flag), continent bars and badges, best speed round and expedition streak. Every word is in the kit's 13 languages, including country names, capitals, facts and all the culture questions: English is built in, and each other language is a reviewed data pack under /vendor/data/atlas-quest/<version>/<lang>.js that the game loads with its sha384 (docs/decisions.md, 'Game data packs'), so a player downloads only their own language and the game file stays under 1 MB. Saves in BRB.storage key 'atlas-quest-v1'. Score: BRB.score.submit(lit countries, 'countries'); BRB.gameOver({ won: true }) when all 195 are lit. Test hooks: window.__brbTest (state, home, mode, answer, next, tapCountry, file, passport, settings, lightAll, camera, pickAt, screenOf, closeModal, closeDialog, cover, make, addCountries, addOwn, preview, arrows, moveArrow, playSet, library, blank, sheets, item).

en-GB.description: Spin a 3D globe and paint the world in flags! Find countries on the map, match flags, hop between capitals, and go on a culture quest through food, festivals, music, words and wildlife. Teachers make their own geography quiz (map labels, capitals, flags, their own questions, or questions drafted from a lesson they upload), share it by link, QR code or class code, assign it, and print it as a worksheet, with blank maps where small countries get an arrow to an answer line. A geography library covers every country plus continents, oceans, rivers, mountains, deserts and lakes.

pt.description: Gire um globo 3D e acenda o mundo! Encontre países no mapa, combine bandeiras, pule entre capitais, encare uma rodada relâmpago de 60 segundos e faça uma nova expedição todo dia. Acerte um país 3 vezes e ele se acende com a bandeira no topo. Toque em qualquer país para abrir a ficha dele: capital, população, idiomas e uma curiosidade. 195 países para colecionar no seu passaporte.

fr.description: Fais tourner un globe en 3D et illumine le monde ! Trouve les pays sur la carte, associe les drapeaux, saute de capitale en capitale, relève le défi éclair de 60 secondes et pars chaque jour pour une nouvelle expédition. Réussis un pays 3 fois et il s’allume avec son drapeau planté dessus. Touche n’importe quel pays pour ouvrir sa fiche : capitale, habitants, langues et une info amusante. 195 pays à collectionner dans ton passeport.

es.description: ¡Gira un globo 3D e ilumina el mundo! Encuentra países en el mapa, empareja banderas, salta entre capitales, compite en una ronda rápida de 60 segundos y emprende una nueva expedición cada día. Acierta un país 3 veces y se ilumina con su bandera encima. Toca cualquier país para abrir su ficha: capital, habitantes, idiomas y un dato curioso. 195 países para coleccionar en tu pasaporte.

de.description: Dreh einen 3D-Globus und bring die Welt zum Leuchten! Finde Länder auf der Karte, ordne Flaggen zu, hüpf von Hauptstadt zu Hauptstadt, schaff die 60-Sekunden-Blitzrunde und starte jeden Tag eine neue Expedition. Beantworte ein Land 3-mal richtig und es leuchtet auf, mit seiner Flagge obendrauf. Tippe auf ein Land, um seinen Steckbrief zu öffnen: Hauptstadt, Einwohner, Sprachen und ein lustiger Fakt. 195 Länder für deinen Reisepass.

he.description: סובבו גלובוס תלת־ממדי והדליקו את העולם! מצאו מדינות על המפה, התאימו דגלים, קפצו בין ערי בירה, התחרו בסיבוב מהיר של 60 שניות וצאו בכל יום למסע חדש. ענו נכון על מדינה 3 פעמים והיא נדלקת עם הדגל שלה. הקישו על כל מדינה כדי לפתוח את הכרטיס שלה: בירה, אוכלוסייה, שפות ועובדה מעניינת. 195 מדינות לאסוף בדרכון.

ja.description: 3Dの地球をまわして、世界に色をつけよう！ 地図で国をさがしたり、国旗をあてたり、首都をめぐったり。60秒のスピードラウンドや、毎日かわる冒険もあるよ。1つの国に3回正解すると、その国が光って国旗が立ちます。どの国でもタップすると、首都・人口・言語・おもしろ豆知識がわかる「国のファイル」がひらきます。パスポートに195か国をあつめよう！
ja.tags: 地理,世界,地図,地球儀,国旗,国,首都,クイズ,3d,べんきょう,毎日のパズル

ar.description: أدِر كرة أرضية ثلاثية الأبعاد وأضِئ العالم! ابحث عن الدول على الخريطة، وطابق الأعلام، وتنقّل بين العواصم، وتسابق في جولة سريعة مدتها 60 ثانية، وانطلق كل يوم في رحلة استكشاف جديدة. أجب عن دولة إجابة صحيحة 3 مرات فتضيء ويرتفع علمها فوقها. المس أي دولة لتفتح ملفها: العاصمة والسكان واللغات ومعلومة طريفة. 195 دولة تجمعها في جواز سفرك.

ru.description: Крути 3D-глобус и зажги весь мир! Находи страны на карте, угадывай флаги, прыгай по столицам, проходи 60-секундный скоростной раунд и каждый день отправляйся в новую экспедицию. Ответь про страну правильно 3 раза — и она засветится, а на ней появится флаг. Нажми на любую страну, чтобы открыть её карточку: столица, население, языки и интересный факт. 195 стран для твоего паспорта.

it.description: Fai girare un globo 3D e accendi il mondo! Trova i paesi sulla mappa, abbina le bandiere, salta da una capitale all’altra, sfida il round veloce da 60 secondi e parti ogni giorno per una nuova spedizione. Indovina un paese 3 volte e si illumina con la sua bandiera sopra. Tocca un paese qualsiasi per aprire la sua scheda: capitale, abitanti, lingue e una curiosità. 195 paesi da collezionare nel tuo passaporto.

zh-Hant.description: 轉動3D地球，點亮全世界！在地圖上找國家、配對國旗、在首都之間跳躍、挑戰60秒快速回合，每天還有新的探險路線。同一個國家答對3次，它就會亮起來，插上國旗。點任何國家都能打開它的檔案：首都、人口、語言和一則有趣的小知識。195個國家等你收集進護照！
zh-Hant.tags: 地理,世界,地圖,地球儀,國旗,國家,首都,問答,3d,學習,每日挑戰

nl.description: Draai een 3D-wereldbol en laat de wereld oplichten! Zoek landen op de kaart, koppel vlaggen, spring van hoofdstad naar hoofdstad, doe de snelle ronde van 60 seconden en ga elke dag op een nieuwe expeditie. Heb je een land 3 keer goed, dan licht het op met zijn vlag erop. Tik op een land om het dossier te openen: hoofdstad, inwoners, talen en een leuk weetje. 195 landen om te verzamelen in je paspoort.
